newsitem.title: USA: Cable extends Bell Cablemedia tender.
newsitem.headline: Cable extends Bell Cablemedia tender.

text.p: Cable and Wireless Communications Plc said Monday it extended its tender offer for Bell Cablemedia Plc and NYNEX Corp's CableComms Group in Great Britain and the United States.
The offer will expire August 14 at 0930 EDT/1330 GMT, unless further extended the company said.
The company said it exercised its rights to buy all outstanding ordinary shares of Bell Cablemedia and NYNEX CableComms UK, including those represented by American Depositary Receipts on June 17.

Cable and Wireless said it proposed June 23 to holders of 3.5 percent convertible Bell Cablemedia notes and 5 percent convertible notes to issue Cable and Wireless shares for their notes instead of Bell Cablemedia shares.
